A single-fascicle anonymous Chinese sister-version to [T145](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6a/KR6a0145), printed by the Taishō as T142b. The two represent two parallel manuscript traditions of the same anonymous Western-Jìn rendering.

The Western Jìn (265–317) ascription is a catalog-tradition assignment. The defensible bracket is recorded in the frontmatter. The Indic source is presumed lost.
